title: THE BIGGEST SCAM!
body: These people, even though you cancelled it long time ago, after months they pretend that you just took their test and successfully purchased subscription. They definitely refuse your refund request, also on the app you still don’t even have the premium features even though they charged you €79,99! Please block it with your bank account, otherwise they won’t stop drawing money from your bank. There are many people like me if you search online. Have no idea why Apple doesn’t do anything about these thiefs!

title: Content doesn’t open
body:
I tried to open my challenge for today and it doesn’t open. 
Content is oversimplified meaningless rubbish you could find much better advice just by googling, sometimes ‘written’ (do I mean plagerised?) with annoying syntax and English errors. No way will this help anyone to break their bad habits. 
I paid 10€ to trial this crap. I’d like my money back please.
author: somaaaaad

title: Go away 🤷🏻‍♀️
body: I’ve seen the app in a FB add that takes 5min of your time pretending to build your profile with information that are NOT stored anywhere… so when you download the app, they don’t have the answer you provided. The app don’t give you any option but paying when you join, so there is no way you can test the app without giving your credit card, subscribing. The graphics might be pretty, the marketing system is disgusting. Looks like a scam to me. My advice : don’t give your money to app you don’t trust to be good. From they add system, seems to me they don’t care about user experience.
author: Enid Lilith Goode
